nm:output.nm:control_stream:
$PROB TGI LLC, EXPONENTIAL, V0 FIXED P:ROOT F:BASE $INPUT ID TIME DV MDV $DATA ../../data/tgi-llc.csv IGNORE=@ $PRED V0 = 1 ; 10^6 cells = 1 mm3 at day 0. Design, not data A = THETA(1) * EXP(ETA(1)) F = V0 * EXP(A * TIME) IPRE = F W = SQRT(THETA(2)**2 + THETA(3)**2 * IPRE**2) IF (W.LT.1E-6) W = 1E-6 IRES = DV - IPRE IWRE = IRES / W Y = IPRE + W * EPS(1)
$THETA (0, 0.5) ; A, growth rate (1/day) (0, 10) ; additive error SD (mm3) (0, 0.2) ; proportional error CV
$OMEGA 0.05 ; A
$SIGMA 1 FIX
$EST MAX=9999 PRINT=5 METHOD=COND INTER NSIG=3 SIGL=9 NOABORT NOTBT NOOBT NOSBT $COV UNCOND PRINT=ERS $TAB ID TIME DV MDV IPRE IWRE CWRES ONEHEADER NOPRINT FILE=sdtab $TAB ID A ETA1 ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=patab $TAB ID TIME ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=cotab $TAB ID MDV ONEHEADER NOPRINT NOAPPEND FILE=catab
